id: title:dmarchuk:let a person say why they rejected a suggestion

review.posthog_relevance: Adds rejection reason tracking and preservation to the workflow proposal rejection process, including database storage, API request/response serialization, and frontend UI input, with a retry mechanism to preserve user-entered reasons.
review.reason: The change implements a bounded capability: adding a rejection reason field across the database model, ORM record, API request/response serializers, and frontend UI. This supports workflow producers recording and retaining rejection reasons, and preserves user effort during API failures. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 narrow-only maintenance is demonstrated; the change
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include backend implementation, database migration, or tests, so it cannot establish if the reason field is actually persisted, returned, or used by the backend, or if the frontend changes are compatible with the backend. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 narrow-only maintenance is demonstrated; the change is a substantive, bounded capability. No tier 3

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is requested, so no score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds rejection_reason field to WorkflowProposalRecord, WorkflowProposal model, and WorkflowProposalSerializer; adds reason field to WorkflowProposalRejectRequestSerializer; stores rejection reason when rejecting; orders rejected proposals by resolved_at; tests rejection with and without reason; preserves reason on retry.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows workflow producers to record why a suggestion was rejected, and read that reason before suggesting again, preventing repeated rejections of the same idea.

observations.behavior: Adds rejection_reason field to WorkflowProposal model and its help_text.
observations.posthog_connection: Stores the rejection reason in the database for each proposal, supporting the workflow of reading the reason before resubmitting.

observations.behavior: Adds rejection_reason field to WorkflowProposalRecord and its help_text.
observations.posthog_connection: Passes rejection reason into the record returned to the producer, so the producer can read it before suggesting again.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the backend implementation, database migration, or tests. It cannot establish if the reason field is actually persisted, returned, or used by the backend, or if the frontend changes are compatible with the backend. It also does not include the workflow proposal creation or rejection API implementation, only the request/response schema and the frontend UI

observations.behavior: Adds LemonField and LemonTextArea imports, and changes rejectProposal and confirmRejectProposal action signatures to accept an optional or required reason string.
observations.code_quote: rejectProposal: (proposalId: string, reason?: string) => ({ proposalId, reason }),
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the workflow proposal rejection action to carry a reason string, which is passed to the backend.

observations.behavior: Replaces LemonDialog.open with LemonDialog.openForm, adds a LemonTextArea for the rejection reason, and passes the reason to the backend API.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the UI reason input to the backend rejection request, including the reason in the payload.

observations.behavior: Adds a retry mechanism that reopens the rejection dialog with the user's reason if the backend request fails, preserving the reason.
observations.code_quote: // Reopen with what they wrote, so a failed request does not cost them the reason.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves user effort by retaining the rejection reason after a failed API request, rather than clearing it.
